      • teachPlayerSkill

        default void teachPlayerSkill​(IPlayer player,
                              boolean postEvent)
        Teaches the player this skill if they don't already have it unlocked.
        Does not take TP, only mind.
        Does not check if the player has enough mind.
        The event is posted only if postEvent == true **and** the player does not already have the skill.
        Equivalent of calling teachPlayerSkill(player, 1, postEvent)
        Parameters:
        player - player to teach
        postEvent - whether the event should be posted to scripts (only posted if the player doesn't have the skill already)

      • teachPlayerSkill

        default void teachPlayerSkill​(IPlayer player)
        Teaches the player this skill if they don't already have it unlocked.
        Does not take TP, only mind.
        The event is not posted.
        Equivalent of calling teachPlayerSkill(player, 1, false)
        Parameters:
        player - player to teach

      • teachPlayerSkill

        void teachPlayerSkill​(IPlayer player,
                      int level,
                      boolean postEvent)
        If the player doesn't have this skill or their current level is below the one provided, their level is set to the new level.
        Does not take TP, only mind.
        The event is posted only if postEvent == true **and** the skill is newly learned.
        Parameters:
        player - player to teach
        level - level to set (if level > #getMaxLevel(), level is treated as max level)
        postEvent - whether the event should be posted to scripts (only posted if the skill is newly learned)

      • teachPlayerSkill
